status: Declared before server architecture training; NN3 is an existing in-progress experiment

definitions.certification: The export bundle_manifest.json hashes this plan and every transferred code/data file. Executable definitions govern execution; changes require a new bundle and documented plan version.

objectives: Complete the matched NN3 versus OLS/ridge/lasso/elastic-net study across three fitting windows.
Compare fixed hidden-layer depths at the primary 504-session fitting window.
Optionally compare widths at fixed three-layer depth.
Optionally evaluate monthly validation-selected depth separately from fixed architectures.

network.parameter_count: All trainable linear weights/biases and BatchNorm affine parameters; exclude running statistics.
network.interpretation: Depth comparisons fix the first-layer width, not the total parameter count. Width sensitivity fixes depth.

data.timing: Signal t is the first nominal 16:00 Eastern close at/after each post; forecast close t to close t+1. Known early-close routing limitation is retained.
data.label_correction: Use corrected immutable prepared cache, including FTNW next-observed-session horizon exclusion and same-date target reranking.
data.feature_transform: Scalar features use same-date centered average ranks in [-1,1]; embeddings/agreement remain unranked. Fit-window equal-date means/scales are applied to validation/test.
data.target_transform: Same-date centered return ranks in [-0.5,0.5]; at least 10 observations and nonconstant targets for an eligible target date.
data.sample: Prediction eligibility does not depend on future labels. Comparisons use common rows within each target family. Raw and DGTW outcome coverage may differ.

splits.boundary_rule: For b=last session before test month and h=1: valid_last=b-h, valid_first=b-h-V+1, fit_last=valid_first-h-1, fit_first=fit_last-F+1.
splits.holdout_status: Historical development evidence; no claim of an untouched test period.

training.loss: 0.5 equal-date weighted MSE of rank targets + 0.5 lambda sum of squared Linear weights
training.date_weights: Each eligible fitting date has equal total weight; each eligible stock within a date receives equal weight.
training.penalized_parameters: Linear weights only; biases and BatchNorm parameters excluded
training.seed_checkpoint_selection: Each seed uses its best mean daily validation IC checkpoint under the improvement rule.
training.penalty_selection: Maximum mean daily validation IC of five-seed mean predictions; exact ties choose the first declared penalty.
training.test_prediction: Mean of the five selected seed predictions at the validation-selected penalty.
training.test_outcome_use: No test outcomes determine preprocessing, training, stopping, penalty or architecture choices.
training.resource_policy: Worker count can change after profiling without changing model identity. Thread count/runtime changes create distinct identities and block incompatible legacy reuse.

unique_compute_before_checkpoint_reuse.reuse_rule: Identical NN3 model/month specifications share server checkpoints across phases. Certified compatible local NN3 checkpoints can replace training under an inference-bridge receipt.

pilot_policy.training_budget: Complete standard seeds, penalties and epoch ceiling; no reduced-budget scientific results.
pilot_policy.reference_benchmark: F504 raw core/textcore, January 2014, March 2015, December 2022; six jobs.
pilot_policy.large_block_benchmark: F756 raw textall, January 2014, March 2015, December 2022; three jobs.
pilot_policy.architecture_pilot: All depth phase specifications for January 2014; 32 jobs, reusable in matching full server runs.
pilot_policy.purpose: Check numerical behavior, elapsed time, allocation and restart behavior. Test outcomes do not alter the registered menu.
pilot_policy.benchmark_isolation: Benchmark outputs are isolated from scientific study registries; resource sweeps repeat identical workloads in fresh interpreters.
pilot_policy.epoch_ceiling: Inspect and report ceiling hits; do not silently lower budgets or discard difficult candidates.

evaluation.portfolio_ties: Fractional boundary weights; constant forecasts hold cash; at least 10 fractional stock equivalents per decile.

uncertainty.method: Calendar-aware HAC for daily paired differences

evaluation.multiplicity: Bonferroni within target/family/metric/period over all registered contrasts. HAC lags are sensitivities, not selected. Optional phases are declared extensions, not unadjusted searches for a winner.
evaluation.feature_contrasts: all/core, textcore/core, textall/core, textall/all within estimator and history
evaluation.estimator_contrasts: Every non-OLS versus OLS, and every NN versus each ridge/lasso/elastic-net baseline at fixed inputs/history
evaluation.history_contrasts: F252/F756 versus F504 in the NN3 phase
evaluation.architecture_contrasts: Each registered alternative versus NN3 at identical features/target/F504; no all-pairs architecture search
evaluation.economic_limitations: Gross sorts do not account for costs or establish executable same-close returns.

optional_adaptive_depth.selection: Monthly maximum ensemble validation IC across all four architectures, each with its previously validation-selected penalty.
optional_adaptive_depth.exact_ties: Fewer trainable parameters, then declared order nn1, nn2, nn3, nn4.
optional_adaptive_depth.benchmark: Fixed NN3 within feature/target, in a separately declared adaptive family.
optional_adaptive_depth.outputs: Separate depth_adaptive report and monthly selection ledger. Fixed-depth report remains primary.
